passage_judgments.label_basis: Pooled top-result chunks and source pages were manually reviewed to label selected passages that directly answer each question. IDs use document_id::chunk::chunk_index from the ready corpus snapshot on 2026-09-27; the pool is not exhaustive and labels must be reviewed after re-ingestion or re-chunking.

database_snapshot.evaluated_company: Công ty Cổ phần Sữa Việt Nam (Vinamilk)

configuration.authorization: database allowed_roles filter before retrieval ranking
configuration.fiscal_year_boost: exact document fiscal_year match when query names one year

parent.parent_context: up to 2 neighboring chunks on either side with the same section title and page; same-page fallback when no section title exists

configuration.latency_note: Dense, hybrid, and parent latency include first-use embedding model initialization on their first query; BM25 does not load the embedding model.

limitations: 12-case demo set with manually assigned passage IDs tied to the current chunk-index snapshot; document and passage judgments are limited and need broader independent review. BM25 is a SQL implementation with k1=1.2 and b=0.75. Parent mode expands retrieved contexts, so its passage ranking is flattened from the returned child indices. No reranker or answer-generation comparison is included.
